text_block_list.text:
The day of the Victoria Mile. No matter 
how much she pondered what she lacked, no 
answer came. Vodka decided to stop 
thinking about it.

In this race decided in an instant, 
perhaps running without thinking until 
burning out completely might help grasp 
something.

With that premonition held close to her 
heart, Vodka headed out toward the race.
